question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Comutter'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word of the given words is: **'Comutter'.**
 
• The correct spelling of word is: **'Commuter'**.(कम्यूटर)
 
• The word **'Comutter'** is a **noun **meaning a person who travels some distance to work on a regular basis.
 
 
• **Example**: *A fault on the line caused widespread delays for commuters.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: **'****Commission' **means an instruction, command, or role given to a person or group.
 
• **Option 3**: **'****Committee'** means a body of one or more persons subordinate to a deliberative assembly.
 
• **Option 4**: **'****Camouflage'** means hide or disguise the presence of a person, animal, or object.
